description: decoder_base.v (build A) vs decoder_changed.v (build B): the address decode for SEL2/SEL3 was swapped. Same boundary, same register names.
notes: Expected outcome: sel_reg_2.D and sel_reg_3.D are refuted with a witness; every other observation point is proven equivalent.
HIT is expected to be proven equivalent -- swapping two decode terms does not change the OR of all four, which is exactly why a top-level-output-only check would miss this regression.
